name: onedevr
install:
Rscript -e 'baseline <- c("httr2","jsonlite","rlang","testthat","mockery","withr","devtools","roxygen2","knitr","rmarkdown"); miss <- baseline[!vapply(baseline, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]; if (length(miss)) install.packages(miss, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")'
Rscript -e 'if (file.exists("DESCRIPTION")) tryCatch(devtools::install_deps(".", upgrade = "never"), error = function(e) message("install_deps skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)))'
